@@note: German. A machine translation, not yet reviewed by a native speaker. Made from the mobile app's translations (mstream_music, master at bdb174e, lib/l10n/app_de.arb, GPL-3.0) and the terminal player's (mstream-terminal-player, main at b89ad0a, locales/de.yml, GPL-3.0-only; both by this repository's owner) where they had the text or its words: du, „…“, Titel, Album, Künstler, Ordner, Bibliothek, Warteschlange, Abspielen, Als Nächstes, Zufallswiedergabe, Kopfhörer, gekoppelt, Verbinden, Trennen, Vergessen, Akku, Karte, Sleep-Timer, Touch-Kalibrierung, Erneut versuchen, Speichern, Fertig. Translated by a Fable agent (Claude) otherwise, then reviewed by a second Fable agent (meaning against each text's context, terms, grammar and plurals, register, typography, the rooms). Notes in "@<id>" say where a shorter word replaced the apps' one for the room. The rooms the notes give are those the texts were fitted to (42356b7); the layout fixes since gave most buttons and pills 2-4 px more and Small when their font doesn't fit, so a few of the apps' words a note set aside would fit now (docs/I18N.md, phase 3, lists them for a native review). The Auto DJ texts (October 2026, the engine's UI: toast.autodj_*, now_playing.autodj*, library.autodj_here, empty.autodj, output.autodj*, autodj.*) were made the same way: the mobile app's words for Auto DJ, Anker, Der Stimmung folgen, Ausgangssong, Ähnlichkeitsschwelle, BPM-Kontinuität and Harmonisches Mixen (its autoDj* keys), translated by a Fable agent otherwise, fitted to en.json's rooms (the notes say where a room made a text shorter), not yet reviewed by a native speaker.
